lines.t: Developers who made Burnout are building a Star Wars racing game.
Star Wars: Galactic Racer launches October 6th. You race podracers, landspeeders and speeder bikes.
Tracks include Tatooine and Jakku, with 12 players online.
It's the first full Star Wars racing game since 2002. After that, podracing was just a Kinect mini-game.
